reference.title: Typical structure
reference.shortdesc: A sample structure (created by hugo new site) is provided below.

section.p: A sample structure (created by hugo new site) is provided below.
section.codeblock: php my-project/ ├── archetypes/ # templates for new content │ └── default.md ├── content/ # all content (Markdown) ├── layouts/ # templates (HTML with Go syntax) ├── static/ # static files (images, js, css) ├── data/ # data files (YAML, JSON, TOML) ├── i18n/ # translation files ├── config.toml # site configuration (TOML/YAML/JSON) └── themes/ # (optional) themes directory
section.p: Hugo also supports a special _index.md for section pages. The static/ folder is mirrored to the output. For images in content, Hugo’s page bundles allow images next to the MD file; otherwise, put them in static/. Hugo uses Goldmark (a CommonMark-compliant ]Markdown parser) by default. It supports GitHub Flavored extensions (tables, task lists, strikethrough) and has features like footnotes, definition lists, etc. You can enable/disable these in config .toml. Shortcodes (e.g. {{< figure src="/images/pic.jpg" alt="...">}}) allow embedding content or parameterized HTML.
